name: MdcToLoincVitals
title: IEEE 11073-10101 (MDC) metric codes to LOINC — bedside monitoring parameters
description: Consumer-side translation of device-native metric codes to LOINC. BICEPS NumericMetricDescriptor/Type is a CodedValue whose default CodingSystem (when the attribute is omitted) is the IEEE 11073-10101 nomenclature, urn:oid:1.2.840.10004.1.1.1.0.0.1. The Dashboard resolves such codes through this map before it looks up per-channel reliability profiles in clinical_db.json, which are keyed by LOINC. Codes already delivered in LOINC bypass the map. Numeric MDC codes are the 32-bit form (partition 2 SCADA: 2*65536 + term code); the symbolic reference ID is kept in 'display'. Equivalence follows FHIR R4 ConceptMapEquivalence. Mappings were cross-checked against the IHE PCD Rosetta Terminology Mapping tables; 'unmatched' marks a target that was NOT confirmed and is therefore deliberately not translated.
